2457-4289-7824-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

539-3821-4679-5256-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5256-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2443-2841-6662.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-6662.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-4862-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4862-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4112-4247-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-7166-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-7166-8095.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1116-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
5686-6972-7932.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-804-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-804-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-804-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-4871-4976-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1550-4251-5434.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-5434.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4311-4871-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2231-2511-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-2511-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-6965-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1329-4211-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1879-3292-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-1879-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1563-2457-4321-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1563-2457-4365-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2645-6266.easyPrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
2645-6266.notablePrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief has power 5 or greater.
2645-6266.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Redshift.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-6266.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

2196-2821-5803-6071.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to produce at least {3}{U} between The Core and up to one additional land.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
2196-2821-5803-6071.description:
Activate The Core and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, The Core and up to one other land.
Activate The Core and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1018-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
1018-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1018-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullwinder, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2178-2292-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-2292-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

877-1374-5195-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {1} due to Morophon.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Nameless Inversion, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat as desired.

1308-1558-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1308-1558-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2103-2239-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Ardent Elementalist.
2103-2239-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

140-805-1745.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is equal to or greater than half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-805-1745.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat step 1 until you have paid an amount of life equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Debt to the Deathless, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {W}{W}{B}{B} due to Rowan's ability.
Resolve Debt to the Deathless, causing each opponent to lose twice X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

380-3362-5256.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities.

1506-3059-4847.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Malignus.
Malignus does not have summoning sickness.
1506-3059-4847.description:
Activate Malignus by tapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to twice its power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

2232-4618-4667-4882.notablePrerequisites: Instill Energy attached to Elvish Aberration.
2232-4618-4667-4882.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Cast Frog Tongue by paying {G}, attaching it to Elvish Aberration.
Frog Tongue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Frog Tongue trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Instill Energy from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, attaching it to Elvish Aberration.
Instill Energy enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Frog Tongue from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

614-1987-2510-3573.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control at least two artifacts.
614-1987-2510-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

783-1399-3814.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
783-1399-3814.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untap Argothian Elder.
Repeat.
